required_handoff_surface.structural_profile_identity: profile_output_id for LOCATION, MOTION, ORGANISATION and INTERACTION
required_handoff_surface.binding_rule: The base C2 record identity is the deterministic C2 vNext observation_id; structural profile/output identities remain separately referenced and are never flattened into a five-axis state key.

why_not_correctable_inside_current_autho: The binding supersession expressly requires the corrected population to use existing accepted source/C1/C2 artifacts and to BLOCK if a mandatory C2E field is physically absent or needs new semantics.
The accepted real C2 replay materialises sequence-window requests/fingerprints rather than observation records, four-axis formula profile outputs or parent-context bundles.

Choosing and freezing a real-data observation→horizon→level→container→relation→formula→parent orchestration for every target observation would create an upstream C2 materialisation contract that does not currently exist in the accepted replay artifacts.

The signature-contract supersession explicitly denies upstream C2 identity mutation and authorises only the C2E comparison-signature repair, not a new upstream C2 replay semantics/orchestration surface.
Synthesising placeholder structural/parent evidence or treating missing materialised outputs as unchanged would suppress lawful causal evidence and violate the fail-closed handoff rule.

smallest_lawful_resolution.requirement: A separately governed upstream C2 vNext observation-level real-source materialisation packet must freeze deterministic per-observation records, four-axis profile outputs and parent-context bundles from the already accepted June C1/source artifacts using only existing frozen component semantics, with exact provenance, first-valid chronology, determinism and no selector/semantic/outcome/Validation authority.
smallest_lawful_resolution.after_upstream_materialisation: Return to C2E2-G6-REPLACEMENT-RUN-PREP append-only, bind exact C2 observation/profile/parent artifact IDs and hashes, build v0.3 C2EInputFrames, freeze population count/hash, then prepare a new inactive boundary pack, unchanged-limit resource envelope, candidate manifest/token and fresh C2E2-G6-RUN-AUTH operator packet.

rollback: Preserve the merged v0.3 C2E stable-signature candidate and all historical artifacts. Do not create replacement population, pack, envelope, manifest, token or execute WP6. No active authority changed.
